name: Hankyu Hanshin REIT, Inc.
summary: Hankyu Hanshin REIT, Inc. is an integrated real estate investment trust. The firm invests mainly in real estate properties for retail or office use throughout Japan with the purpose of securing stable income over the medium-to-long-term and achieving the best possible returns for unitholders. HHR will focus on investments in the retail-use zone (zone in which visitors receive goods and services in return for payment) and the Kansai Region (the six prefectures of Osaka, Kyoto, Hyogo, Nara, Shiga and Wakayama).
